title: Rosetta config (.rosetta/config.json)
description: Configuration for rosetta-i18n, a free, open-source, self-run localization CLI. See https://github.com/ian/rosetta.

sourceLocale.description: Locale of the source files (e.g. "en"). Source files are read, never written.

engineId.description: Lingo.dev setting — ignored by Rosetta. Configure `engine` instead.

keyPatterns.description: Dotted key paths or globs. `auth` matches auth and everything under it; `*` matches one segment; `**` any depth (e.g. `**.href`).

pattern.description: Source file path or glob, relative to the project root, containing the source locale (messages/en.json, locales/en/**/*.json, pages.en.json).

context.description: Context sent with every request for this file.

lockedKeys.description: Copied from the source untranslated and kept in sync.

engine.description: Local translation engine: model, endpoint, and prompt settings. Required for `rosetta push`.

model.description: Model id, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5. Overridden by ROSETTA_MODEL.

baseURL.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (default https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). Overridden by ROSETTA_BASE_URL.

apiKeyEnv.description: Env var holding the API key (default ROSETTA_API_KEY; OPENROUTER_API_KEY is always a fallback).

brandVoice.description: Locale (or "*" fallback) → brand-voice text, or a path to a .md/.txt file relative to .rosetta/.

rules.description: Linguistic rules appended to every prompt.

glossary.description: Inline glossary ({ locale: { term: rendering } }, with "*" for never-translate terms) or a path to a JSON/JSONC file relative to .rosetta/.
